findings.title: beta-qualify's help and header promise "never writes inside --repo" while it runs the repo's `verify=` in place by default
`cd_scratch` failure is swallowed by command substitution when deriving the rehearsal root, defeating the L014 guard the file claims to apply
shadowing `openssl` can false-trip the rehearsal on a host without `shasum`, which `lib/common.sh` falls back from
